# Install `loading-states` — Loading States — skeletons + spinners SSOT

> Configurable LoadingSkeleton composing the shadcn Skeleton primitive: kind presets text / card / list / table / form / page / block with overridable count + columns.

📚 Knowledge base : https://resource.rahmanef.com/llms.txt
📦 Slice detail   : https://resource.rahmanef.com/slices/loading-states
🧠 JSON catalog   : https://resource.rahmanef.com/api/knowledge?slice=loading-states
🤖 Prompt page    : https://resource.rahmanef.com/agents/loading-states

## 1. Install

```bash
npx rahman-resources add loading-states
# alias: npx rr add loading-states
```

## 2. What it ships

- tags: `loading`, `skeleton`, `spinner`, `suspense`, `fallback`, `placeholder`, `basics`

## 3. Wire it up

Run `npx rr add loading-states`. Pick the LoadingSkeleton kind that mirrors the streamed content (<LoadingSkeleton kind="table" count={8} />); use kind="page" inside route loading.tsx. For in-flight work (submits, refetches) use <LoadingState variant="inline|block|overlay" /> instead of a skeleton.

## Rules of engagement

- shadcn-only UI primitives. No raw `<button>` / `<dialog>` / native date or file inputs.
- 200-line hard cap per source file (extract neighbours when over).
- All Convex queries hit an index (`.withIndex(...)`); never bare `.collect()`.
- Public mutations/queries declare `args:` validators + authz.
- Full ruleset: https://resource.rahmanef.com/best-practice
